commit.subject: LU-16518 osp: remove unused osp buffer/object helpers
commit.message:
LU-16518 osp: remove unused osp buffer/object helpers

... since they are no longer used. osp_buf_prep(),
osp_object_child() and osp_seq_site() have had no callers
since they were introduced.

Fixes: 6c4c51e3079e ("LU-1445 osp: Use FID to track precreate cache.")
Fixes: 044546f88a63 ("LU-1303 osp: Basic OSP device implementation")
Fixes: 519a65ddc046 ("LU-4076 fld: add local fldb to each target")
Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
